title: Define the early-reader remedy for terminal launcher failures before input capture
outcome: The early committed-input reader explicitly classifies real launcher terminal failures with no input key and no stage run, and gives an actionable refusal or preserves the never-started path without weakening malformed-input refusal.
acceptance: Actual startupFailureResult and status-before-input-capture shapes have discriminating reader tests. The chosen policy either treats absent-input Failed/all-unrun results as NotStarted or deliberately retains Unknown with a rerun remedy; present null or malformed input remains Unknown.
The remedy is documented in the typed refusal or nearby contract and does not admit a newer failed stage result through an older PASS.
